resolutions.researcher_notes: This is a segment of Saudi Aramco's UBTG (Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas) system feeding Ju'aymah, part of the Master Gas System. Fluor's completed Saudi Aramco Gas Program EPC page and the OGN Master Gas System feature both describe this gas gathering/processing/trunkline network across Shedgum, Uthmaniyah, Ju'aymah, Berri and Jubail as built and in operation. Neither names this exact GEM segment, but both confirm the UBTG/MGS gas system is operating. Seed OPEC ASB citations are country-level statistics and do not support a segment status; not cited.

Fuel=Gas is well supported: Fluor describes this as a gas gathering and processing system (>3 bcf/d sour gas feed producing sweet dry gas), and OGN describes the Master Gas System distributing sales/dry gas. The UBTG-to-Ju'aymah lines are dry-gas / NGL trunklines of the gas program. Two independent sources agree it is gas infrastructure.

No independent source verifies LengthKnown=204 km for this specific UBTG-Ju'aymah segment. CONTRADICTION flag: independent descriptions of the UBTG lines give different figures - the UBTG-3 underground line linking Uthmaniyah to Ju'aymah and Berri is repeatedly reported as 152 km, and a Shedgum-Uthmaniyah line as ~193 km. 204 km could not be corroborated and conflicts with these. Seed OPEC ASB is country-level and cannot support a segment length. Left UNRESOLVED.

No independent source states Diameter=28,30,38,40 in for this segment. These multi-diameter values match the pattern GEM carries for sibling UBTG/Ju'aymah-Jubail segments and appear to originate from an unpublished engineering/GIS source rather than any citable public document. Seed OPEC ASB does not carry pipe diameters. Could not corroborate; left UNRESOLVED.

StartCountryOrArea and EndCountryOrArea = Saudi Arabia. Both sources place the UBTG/Master Gas System facilities (Uthmaniyah, Ju'aymah, Berri, Shedgum, Jubail) in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. The line runs Uthmaniyah gas plant to Ju'aymah, both in Saudi Arabia. Two independent sources agree.

Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100%. Fluor names Saudi Aramco as the client/operator of the Gas Program that built this gas gathering/trunkline network; OGN describes the Master Gas System as Saudi Aramco's. The entire UBTG/MGS system is wholly Aramco-owned. Two independent sources agree on Saudi Aramco ownership.
